subject: Trial top-up & schedule for head-to-head RFP
messages:
From: Sam Taylor <sam.taylor@velotech.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: extra trial credits + 30 day extension for RFP eval

Hi Hannah,

Hope you had a good week. We're running a head-to-head RFP this month between Redwood and two other vendors. The scoring committee has asked for additional throughput testing under 8K token sequences and a longer window to complete the integration tests.

Can Redwood provide a trial top-up (approximately $10k worth of credits) and a 30-day extension to our current sandbox access? Procurement is also requesting a short mutual action plan they can attach to their internal packet. If there are any paperwork or procurement paths you prefer (SOW, PO, or a one-off credit agreement), let me know.

Appreciate it — goal is to have final scoring by end of November.

Thanks,
Sam Taylor
Head of Integrations
Velotech

Hi Sam — great to hear from you and thanks for the context. We can support the head-to-head testing. Here’s what I can offer today: 30 days extension on the sandbox and an incremental $10k trial credit pool that will be applied to the Velotech account for benchmarking only (won't auto-convert to a paid commitment).

A couple of asks so we can finalize quickly:
- Can you confirm the procurement contact (procure@velotech.com is fine) and whether a PO will be issued?
- We typically attach a short Mutual Action Plan (single-sheet) that covers timelines, acceptance criteria, and who runs the tests. I can send a template for edits.
- Please confirm the max sequence length and target QPS you want us to size for (you mentioned 8K tokens).

I’m looping in Ben to confirm the credit treatment and Marcus for any provisioning details. If that works, I’ll send the MAP + draft SOW and a DocuSign link to make it official for procurement.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt

Hannah / Marcus —

We should treat the $10k as promotional trial credit tied to the Velotech account and flagged in billing as "eval_credit" so it does not impact committed spend metrics. Ops: please ensure the sandbox quota is increased to allow peak concurrent requests for 8K token sequences; that usually requires bumping up GPU memory reservation and enabling prefix cache. Marcus — can you confirm the provisioning window (48 hours once we get PO/confirmation)?

Also recommend including a simple clause in the MAP: credits expire 60 days from activation and cannot be transferred to other accounts. Keeps accounting clean.

Ben
